create.title: Create a package
create.body: Name it vendor/package. You can create it from the Packages page or via the API.

upload.title: Upload a ZIP or connect Git
upload.body: Upload a release archive manually, or configure a Git source so releases sync automatically.

install.title: Install via Composer
install.body: Point Composer at this repository, then composer require your package.

composer.title: Composer repository
composer.authNote: Authenticate with a token from <0>API Tokens</0>. Use the token as the username and <1>satispress</1> as the password.
